name: synergieloc
description: Buildings and French real-estate law for Grok Build, through the hosted Synergieloc MCP server: describe a building in JSON and get a checked scene, dimensioned DXF, IFC 4 model, BIM rule checks, quantities, cost estimates, permit drafts and a 4K walkthrough; plus French rental management (IRL rent review, service-charge settlement, rent receipts) with their legal basis.
